idea: Add 2-step multi-token prediction auxiliary loss with forward curriculum: weight 0.0->0.3 over warmup, primary NTP loss unchanged
evidence: DeepSeek-V4 keeps MTP with loss weight 0.3; Qwen3.6 model cards list MTP trained with multi-steps; modded-nanogpt record #53 gained from MTP; results.tsv has no MTP experiment.
notes: Add 2 lightweight future-token heads or shared lm_head shifted targets; eval remains evaluate_bpb NTP only. Risk: extra loss can hurt small models, so ramp gradually per MTP curriculum paper.

idea: Add GPU-resident hashed bigram embedding: hash(prev_token,current_token) into 2^16-2^17 buckets, add to x0 before norm
evidence: modded-nanogpt record #62 Bigram Hash Embedding and #68 GPU bigram hash were recent wins; DeepSeek-V4 also uses token-ID hash routing in early MoE; results.tsv has no bigram/hash test.
notes: Captures local BPE pair statistics missing from unigram wte/value_emb. Keep hash table modest to stay <11.5GB. Risk: embedding params + Adam state increase VRAM and collisions may add noise.

idea: Orthogonalize Q and K weights per attention head in Muon update instead of whole fused matrix
evidence: modded-nanogpt record #80 (2026-04-08) improved by orthogonalizing Q/K matrices in pairs of heads; current optimizer orthogonalizes each full c_q/c_k matrix; results.tsv has no per-head Muon geometry test.
notes: Low architectural risk and no forward-pass cost. Reshape only Q/K Muon updates to head groups, leaving V/O/MLP untouched. Risk: implementation complexity in stacked optimizer groups.

idea: Split single shared value_emb into 3 grouped value-embedding banks for early/mid/late attention layers, keeping ve_gate
evidence: modded-nanogpt records #63, #65, and #70 found value-embed untying/layout/gate tuning wins; only VE weight decay was tried here (94d986b) and failed for a different reason.
notes: Tests capacity/gradient-path layout, not regularization. Start with 3 banks to control VRAM. Risk: extra Adam states may push close to VRAM cap, and current single VE may already be sufficient.

idea: Add single learned output backout from layer 11 activation to final logits path: x_final = x + alpha*h11 before final norm
evidence: modded-nanogpt backout records and later single-saved-activation record #77 suggest reusing one mid-layer latent improves final prediction; c44037e only ruled out full all-prior attention residuals as compile/OOM-heavy.
notes: Static one-activation version should be compile-friendly and cheap. Choose layer 11 just before current MLP-only band. Risk: storing one extra activation may increase VRAM; alpha must init 0.
